sloka: यदि तावत्त्वमिन्द्रेण प्रेषितो रावणालयम् ।तत्त्वमाख्याहि मा भूत्ते भयं वानर मोक्ष्यसे ।। ५.५०.८।।।।
transliteration: yadi tāvattvamindreṇa preṣito rāvaṇālayam ।tattvamākhyāhi mā bhūtte bhayaṁ vānara mokṣyase ।। 5.50.8।।।।

translations.english: "Have you came to the abode of Ravana sent by Indra? Speak the truth. Be not afraid.You will be released".
